scope: Official platform recommendations and representative public editing-tool documentation; not an exhaustive survey of every website or social post.

implementation.caption_catalogue_description: 32 typographic recipes with six palette/size variants; not 192 separate animation algorithms

reference_mapping.1906: Equal-height 50/50 stacked speakers, white/lime short captions at the seam
reference_mapping.1905: Four panels with speaker-and-neighbour context: partition all stable verified people into four spatial groups when more than four are visible; preserve a precomposed vertical grid
reference_mapping.1904: Adjacent portrait panels in an 810-pixel central band, softened top/bottom and captions below
reference_mapping.1901: Seated medium portrait and short coral serif captions; no second zoom on a well-composed vertical input
reference_mapping.1902: Evidence-cued solo detail plus body context; not a fabricated second speaker
reference_mapping.1869: Optional face-clear white title card with black text, restrained word captions
reference_mapping.1867: Centred close-up and short white/accent captions
reference_mapping.diagonal_request: Face-safe upper-left/lower-right diagonal, only when source pixels fill its visible regions

main_choices: Plan before rendering with source/output timestamp mapping
Single-person close-up; verified 2+ person moments <=2 seconds use the one blur-backed fit; longer dialogue uses duo/split/diagonal; grids cover 3/4/crowds
Offline bounded smooth tracking, breath-gap tolerance, native cuts and local-only uncertainty repairs
Short bounded face occlusions are interpolated without new speech evidence; unstable participant populations use a local shared view before resuming normal framing
Plan against displayed video dimensions after phone rotation metadata, matching FFmpeg/OpenCV decoded pixels
Padded verified face envelopes; upper-left/lower-right diagonal polygon checks
Short measured two-line captions with stable placement, colour contrast and gentle emphasis
Added music, SFX and every B-roll path remain removed at the user's request
Bundled OFL font assets, real typography recipes and creator-scoped non-repeating caption selection
Exact native-cut scan, backfilled analysis warm-up, fixed phrase geometry and cut-aligned caption position
Source sharp-coverage guard avoids floating picture cards when input portraits are already tightly cropped
Same visible source/caption-choice menus as the original editor, but independent callbacks and renderer
Grounded hook/title and a clearly labelled local editorial score, not a prediction or platform measurement
1080x1920 high-quality export with fractional source frame rate preserved and conditional low-detail restoration

6.2: one composition per FFmpeg graph, explicit YUV420 negotiation, bounded codec/filter threads, one native-crash CPU compatibility retry and a real pre-install render probe; the reported VPS crash has not been naturally reproduced locally
